value.rationale: This naturally occurring marked two-parameter family is the hyperelliptic three-elliptic-quotient Howe locus, and rank strata of its Jacobian p-divisible groups are structural arithmetic invariants. The complete reduced SNC Hasse divisor and exact double-intersection scheme answer which elliptic quotient supersingularities coexist and prove that three cannot coexist for a smooth characteristic-five member. The changed geometry of the nonordinary divisor compared with characteristic seven is mathematically substantive, not merely a numerical table increment. It supplies exact geometric information for future moduli and degeneration questions; no global conjecture or isomorphism-class census is asserted.
